name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Customer Success Manager | SaaS Onboarding, Adoption, Retention & Executive Business Reviews
summary: Customer success and account management professional with 15+ years in B2B SaaS, owning the post-sale journey from onboarding through retention and expansion. At Wix I launched 25+ clients per month at 110% of implementation targets and drove a 25% conversion improvement across supported accounts. At Birdeye I used utilization data to flag at-risk partners early and retained all but one of 15-20 (~94%). Consultative by default: I run discovery to find what a customer actually needs, then tie adoption to measurable results in business reviews.

experience.title: Client Success & Implementation — Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Own the client relationship for a portfolio of service businesses, running discovery and onboarding to surface goals, objectives, and operational challenges.
Lead end-to-end onboarding, translating business requirements into system configuration and running hands-on training for owners and frontline staff.
Build performance dashboards and report on a regular cadence, tying adoption to outcomes and turning the data into specific recommendations for leadership.
Identify expansion opportunities with existing clients, recommending and scoping complementary services aligned with their goals.
Design automated onboarding and lifecycle workflows that activate, nurture, and retain customers without manual chasing.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Ran QBRs for ~3 multi-stakeholder client accounts at $20K+/month in ad spend each, presenting ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion results with optimization recommendations.
Resolved client feedback promptly and held delivery quality consistent to protect satisfaction and retention.

bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners (deals ~$10K-$45K) across health, home services, and retail, retaining all but one (~94% retention).
Analyzed partner utilization and performance metrics to flag adoption gaps and at-risk accounts early, recommending interventions that reduced churn.
Led onboarding and training for the partner network, building automated product-training sequences that reduced onboarding friction.
Advised partners on retention strategy and customer health metrics, equipping them to communicate product value.
Collaborated with Product and Engineering to share structured, high-priority customer feedback informing the roadmap.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Built internal processes that improved reporting accuracy, reduced handoff errors, and strengthened cross-team alignment while serving as sales team lead.
